services.name: Kayak Rentals Sirenia Vista Park/Cape Coral
services.desc: Explore the beautiful mangrove islands surrounding Sirenia Vista Park/Matlacha in your kayak or paddle board rental. (PFD/Life Vest and Paddle included). Splash all you want or silently stalk tropical birds and other marine life in the Matlacha Pass Aquatic Preserve! You may see Manatees, Dolphins, Eagles, Ospreys and Stingrays on your self guided kayak rental. We offer 1/2 Day & Full Day Kayak and Paddle Board Rentals at this location at [Sirenia Vista Park](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NgTGZcZLZLGKDoUPA?gst=com.google.maps.preview.copy) Max Weight Capacity per rider may not exceed 275 Pounds All Rentals must be returned by no later than 5pm; no exceptions! Full Day Rentals are $15 more

services.name: Coastal Vibes Sunset Paddle
services.desc: Join us on this specialty off-season sunset kayak tour. Book now and take advantage of our discounted rates during the quieter months! Explore Matlacha’s estuary and discover the unique creatures that call it home — from playful dolphins and gentle manatees to skates, rays, roosting birds, and even jumping fish! Glide through winding, mangrove-lined trails as our certified guides share fascinating insights into Florida’s natural history and ecology. On the way back, we’ll keep an eye out for dolphins and manatees before taking in one of the most stunning sunset views in Matlacha! ✨ Details: Duration: ~2 hours $35 for Single Kayaks $50 for Tandem Kayaks Guided by ACA-Certified Kayak & SUP

services.name: Early Bird Kayak Tour Tarpon Point Marina/Cape Coral
services.desc: Paddle with us on an early morning kayak tour & witness Southwest Florida waters come to life! Join us as we identify and share information about coastal & wetland birds and sea creatures that make this area their home! We may encounter Dolphins, Manatee, Stingray, Skates, Sea Turtles, Great Blue Herons, Osprey and Bald Eagles! Our experienced and knowledgeable Guides are ACA Certified Kayak & SUP Instructors & Florida Master Naturalists well versed on Florida’s ecology and natural history & skilled at spotting local wildlife! Approximately 2 hours long. Guide Gratuity not included. Max Weight Capacity per rider may not exceed 300 Pounds This tour goes out of our location at The Marina

services.name: Mangrove Maze Kayak Tour Tarpon Point Marina/Cape Coral
services.desc: Join us as we provide a guided exploration of the mangrove wilderness on the Caloosahatchee Estuary in Cape Coral! This mangrove coastline provides sustenance and harborage for a variety of birds and marine life such as manatee, rays and dolphins! Our experienced & knowledgeable Guides are ACA Certified Kayak & SUP Instructors & Florida Master Naturalists dedicated to learning and teaching the history, ecology & sustainability of Pine Island Sound. Learn about the Calusa Indian Heritage and their environment when they paddled these very same waters over a thousand years ago!! Approximately 2 hours long. Guide Gratuity not included. Max Weight Capacity per rider may not exceed 300 Pounds

services.name: Guided Paddle Board Nature Tour Tarpon Point Marina/Cape Coral
services.desc: Explore the Caloosahatchee Estuary and learn about the history and ecology of southwest Florida while paddling on a Stand Up Paddle Board!
